name: Verigate Authority
tagline: Give your AI agent an action. Verigate decides if it has the authority.
description: Describe a payment in plain language. Anna AI extracts the payment details, asks about missing or ambiguous information, and performs a separate contextual risk review for beneficiary/purpose mismatches, substituted payment details, urgency, prompt injection and attempts to bypass controls. Verigate then evaluates the exact action with deterministic policy rules and returns ALLOW/WARN/BLOCK. AI risk findings can only escalate a result to WARN; AI can never approve or override a deterministic BLOCK. The app verifies the Ed25519 Decision Receipt against its installation issuer key and exposes the key for independent verification. This is a non-persistent preflight: every recipient is treated as new, cumulative daily-spend and per-minute call limits are not evaluated, and nothing is executed.
